da-false-claim.evidence: The proof claims 'The trace and volume map are linear on the Hecke algebra', allowing it to write $\mathrm{Vol}(\overline{\gamma}) = \mathrm{Vol}(\overline{1}) + \sum \phi_i \mathrm{Vol}(\overline{\sigma_i})$. This is a mathematically false claim. Hyperbolic volume is a highly non-linear geometric invariant of the link complement; it does not extend linearly across linear combinations in the Hecke algebra.
